raskghar_camp.name: Raskghar camp

canon_ref.note: Calruz's camps deep in the dungeon: a large hall, then a long chamber with twin stairs after a move (5.42, 5.43). Map raskghar_camp (M28.1).

raskghar_camp.summary: A dungeon hall where the Raskghar keep their captives.

dungeon_city.name: The dungeon city

canon_ref.note: A dead Drake city behind big doors, guarded by skinned Drakes and animated armour. A three-headed monolith (Skinner, Snatcher, Stalker) stands in a plaza; a half-mile pit is the dungeon's heart (5.42).

dungeon_city.summary: A ruined Drake city in the dungeon. Calruz leads 400 Raskghar there.

cave_goblin_refuge.name: Cave Goblin refuge

canon_ref.note: A cave a few miles east of Liscor beside the dungeon, with a bricked-over hole into it. The Redfangs bring the Cave Goblins here by boat (5.41).

cave_goblin_refuge.summary: A cave beside the dungeon where the Cave Goblins shelter.

lancrel.name: Lancrel

canon_ref.note: A Human city outside Laken's empire that refused his levy. Rags takes it in under an hour with ram-carrying Hobs (5.23 G).

lancrel.summary: A northern Izril city that falls to Rags's army.
